Several spots are written the long way when a one-line idiom exists. Home.tsx:139-144 is a nested ternary whose first branch (`err instanceof UnresolvedPrdError ? err.message`) gives the same result as the `instanceof Error` branch after it, so it adds nothing. rateLimit.ts:54-58 builds a hex string with an index loop and a `?? 0` guard. `Array.from(bytes, b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')` does it in one line. rateLimit.ts:81-82 clamps a value that lines 78-80 already keep within 1..3600, so neither clamp branch can run. runnerAuth.ts:31-33 checks that a SHA-256 digest is 32 bytes, which it always is. savedList.ts:19-34 casts `row` eight times instead of narrowing it once. JobStatusPanel.tsx:117,129 call `shouldPollJob(hidden, null)`, which is just `!hidden` with a constant argument.

jobStatus.ts:52 `shouldPollJob(hidden, status)` merges two unrelated checks. Every production call passes one of its arguments as a constant: `(hidden, null)` at JobStatusPanel.tsx:117 and :129, and `(false, job.status)` at :170. It is really `!hidden` and `!isTerminalJobStatus`. Only jobStatus.test.ts:188-195 uses both arguments. jobStatus.ts:276 `dismissTrackedJob(hide)` is a trivial wrapper around `clearLastJobId(); hide();`. SavedPrd.tsx:148 declares an empty `rootStyle: CSSProperties = {}` and passes it at :126, so it does nothing. SavedKpiStrip.tsx:10-11,30 takes a `saved` prop whose own doc comment says it is 'same as total'. Saved.tsx:63 passes `saved: total`, so the strip shows a duplicate KPI card from a prop with no independent value.

JobStatusPanel.tsx:140-183 rewrites by hand the fetch, JSON-parse failure, `!response.ok` plus messageFromPayload, parse-to-null, flag.ifActive and abort/timeout sequence that the shared hook useAbortableJsonGet.ts:84-128 already implements. The only thing the panel adds is polling, which the existing hook could support with a retry or interval. Home.tsx:241-253 and :259-271 repeat the same error section (ErrorBanner plus two buttons) in one file instead of reusing one component. env.ts:1-31 declares its own D1Database, D1PreparedStatement and D1Result types. http.ts:77-81 declares a structural `safeParse` schema type instead of `z.ZodType<T>` from zod, which is already a dependency.

The latest substantive app-builder commit, afc5dcb 'real browser/VRT lanes, PRD stack docs, detail-id discovery', names three separate tickets in its subject and touches 35 files (+1635/-987). It adds VRT and browser test lanes (vitest.workspace.ts, src/testing/vrt.ts). It adds a StackReferences feature (StackReferences.tsx, stackReferences.ts). It splits en.ts into jobStatus.ts and templates.ts, naming.ts into namingWords.ts, and capabilities.ts into capabilityKinds.ts and featureMarkdown.ts. It also changes orchestrator checks (fe-breadcrumbs.mjs, fe-resource-links.mjs, collection-api.mjs). Commit 8bc2907 likewise bundles a rate-limit prune, a claim lease, a privacy-page text edit and n8n poller changes. Neither diff is scoped to one ticket.

JSON request bodies are validated with Zod through readValidatedBody (submit.ts:26-32, prds.ts:22-27, claim.ts:35-37, status.ts:51-65). The route path id is also user input, and it is not validated. prd/[id].ts:16 and status.ts:98 only `.trim()` it and reject an empty string. The value then reaches the D1 query (prd/[id].ts:23-27, status.ts:153, status.ts:201-209) with no schema, format check or length bound. The client already has a UUID check, jobStatus.ts:136 `isJobId`, but the server does not use it. submit.ts:28 `appType` also has no `.trim()`, so a whitespace-only value passes `min(1)`.

I grepped functions/ and src/ (excluding tests) for TODO, FIXME, stub, bypass and `return true`. None of the hits is a security check. They are in PRD-generation text and pure helpers. authorizeRunner (runnerAuth.ts:70-91) fails closed: an unset RUNNER_TOKEN returns 503, and a wrong or missing bearer returns 401 after a digest compare. It runs before any work at jobs.ts:22, claim.ts:209 and status.ts:189. enforceRateLimit (rateLimit.ts:123-173) returns 503 when RATE_LIMIT_KEY is unset and 500 on a storage failure, and it is called at submit.ts:42 and prds.ts:35. The public status GET does not select the prompt (status.ts:71-72).

Several branches have no assertion. No test references the Home forge-error panel (Home.tsx:138-146 and :241-271, including the 'idle' fallback). Grepping src and tests for forgeError and UnresolvedPrdError finds only en.ts, prd/* and prd.test.ts, and prd.test.ts covers the generator, not the page. JobStatusPanel's polling, error, timeout, terminal-stop, deploy-link, dismiss and start-new branches (JobStatusPanel.tsx:116-198, 220-247) have no component-level test. JobStatusPanel.test.ts:24-46 renders only the first loading paint, and no Playwright spec touches the panel. SavedPrd's not-found and error branches (SavedPrd.tsx:82-86, 123-124) have no spec either.

The API tests (prds.test.ts:35-60) call the handlers at the Request/D1 seam and check status codes, which is behavioural. The UI tests depend on implementation details and on presence checks. JobStatusPanel.test.ts:39-45 slices the raw HTML and asserts the inline style strings 'min-height:44px' and 'min-width:44px'. Page.test.ts:35-58 regex-parses static markup to imitate getByRole instead of rendering the page. feature-coverage.spec.ts:147-158 ('saved Retry is present') forces a 500 and then only asserts that the Retry button is visible and in the viewport. It never clicks Retry or checks that the list recovers. No test drives the job-status panel's error or timeout branches.

Saved.tsx:67-82 is composed from named components (SavedToolbar, SavedLoading, SavedError, SavedEmpty, SavedKpiStrip, SavedCardList). The other pages are not. Home.tsx:241-271 writes out the same forge-error `<section>`, ErrorBanner and two buttons twice, with page-local style objects at :276-286. SavedPrd.tsx:125-140 writes the whole success view inline. That includes the ready badge, a date paragraph with an inline `style={{ color, fontSize }}` at :131, and a `<pre>` styled by the page's own readyStyle and preStyle at :150-172. Examples.tsx:35-56 writes the filter-chip button group inline, plus an inline style at :32, instead of using a named FilterChips component.

Loading, error and empty states exist, and a failure never renders as an empty success. Saved.tsx:14-36 has loading, error, empty and success. useAbortableJsonGet.ts:89-115 fails closed on bad JSON, non-OK responses and parse failure. SavedPrd.tsx:23-27 has loading, error, not-found and success. The rule also requires an explicit partial state, and no screen has one. savedList.ts:19-28 discards the whole list when one row is malformed, so a partial result becomes a full error. SavedPrd.tsx:123 shows an error with no recovery action, while Saved has a retry at Saved.tsx:73. A 404 with a non-JSON body takes the generic parse-error path (useAbortableJsonGet.ts:91-95) with no httpStatus, so SavedPrd's not-found mapping at :85 never runs for it.
